profile.headline: Rasputin, Level 2 at CoActiveSoft
profile.summary: We're looking for developers! Great company, great culture, and if you come work here I'll teach you how to juggle.

positions.title: Director of Software Development
positions.description:
• Led the IT Department through a wholesale replacement of our Finance system, managing the integration between the new system and the remaining resident systems.  Also a key member of the Strategy Team driving the global project roll-out
• Led the implementation of a complete CI/CD pipeline for our entire product portfolio using Azure DevOps, converting our legacy deployment process to a fully-automated, “push button” process.
• Led the team in the reformation of our development process, driving toward a Lean/Kanban approach that greatly improved visibility and throughput
• Led the team to implement comprehensive, real-time monitoring across our entire portfolio resulting in “at-a-glance” health status of the software and hardware in our ecosystem 
• Acted as a hand-on Solutions Architect for our integration engine, a custom build ETL engine that connects a disparate number of on-premise and distributed systems.  Wrote production code in C# and Angular

positions.title: Interim Chief Information Officer
positions.description:
Responsible for all operational aspects of the IT department across Infrastructure, Development, and Operations.
- Managed a global department of 45, with team members spread across 22 countries in Europe, Africa, Asia, and North America
- Led the IT Department in the roll-out of our ERP replacement 
- Led the team to harden our infrastructure after several high-visibility phishing attacks
- Developed a security "roadshow" and presented it to teams across the organization, driving better understanding of security risks, greatly decreasing the number of successful attacks
- Hired and managed team members on multiple continents

positions.title: Software Development Manager
positions.description:
Led two cross-functional development teams in the build out of a complete platform for travel agency search, reservation, booking and back office integration.

Provided direction and consultation on process improvements, participated in architectural discussions, while managing day-to-day delivery of software.

positions.title: Individual Contributor
positions.description:
•	Conceived, designed and built an IP-based home intercom system for my house
•	Created an inventory management system for a wholesale tree nursery using RESTful web services and an Angular (2+) front end
•	Learned Java
•	Took up Android development; built my first mobile app, including API and database work
•	Built the iOS version of that app using Swift
•	Learned LESS; redesigned/rebuilt several small company websites using Bootstrap/LESS
•	Learned how to make a really great omelet
•	Learned how to weld
